protocol.hypothesis: Among fully scored same-target Peasant kill ties with identical paired immediate outcomes, retaining a square nearer remaining ranged/caster output may improve later play without spending more search. This is a new pre-neural geometric tie-break, not a revival of shortlist coverage or a generic armor bonus.
protocol.policy: Peasant with active Bitter Experience only. Ordinary safe move/single strike. Fully completed existing H64 complementary R2, primary maximum exact tie. Both root samples must kill same target, same actor HP/bodies/armor/steps/Bitter and supported cheap-response price projection, and identical full state of all other surviving units. Require at least1 Euclidean cell nearer remaining visible shooter/offensive spell output in BOTH samples, no new enemy adjacency. Choose least average distance, catalog order ties. Apply after ordinary material/intent decision, before unchanged final neural correction. No added rollouts, no catalog insertion, no model fit.

limitations: The all-zero empirical bootstrap interval is degenerate because every observed paired score difference is zero; it is not proof of zero population effect or a bound on unseen rare outcomes.
